STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray: fried egg, toasted bread slice, an English muffin half, a blueberry-style muffin, coffee with creamer and sugar packets.

STEP 2 - Vessel: Two plates. The main plate (left) is roughly 20 cm diameter, area ~314 cm². The second plate (right, holding the muffin) is roughly 16 cm, area ~200 cm². The muffin is on the smaller plate, which is part of this meal. The coffee mug is a separate vessel and is not counted as food volume beyond its contents.

STEP 3 - Items: fried egg, slice of toasted bread (brown, multigrain-style), English muffin (toasted), blueberry muffin, coffee with creamer (small amount).

STEP 4 - Area (of the 20 cm plate, 314 cm²): fried egg ~12% (38 cm²), toast ~17% (53 cm²), English muffin ~13% (41 cm²). Muffin on the small plate covers ~ 40% of its 200 cm² plate, roughly 14% of the main-plate-equivalent area in footprint terms.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Fried egg: 38 cm² x 1.0 cm = 38 ml
- Toast slice: 53 cm² x 1.2 cm = 64 ml
- English muffin half: 41 cm² x 2.0 cm = 82 ml
- Blueberry muffin: ~8 cm diameter top, ~6 cm tall = ~250 ml (outer envelope)

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Egg: 38 x 0.95 = 36 g
- Toast: 64 x 0.3 (bread slice, low-density) ≈ 20 g. Bread slice of ~30 g is more typical; use 30 g.
- English muffin half: 82 x 0.35 ≈ 30 g (muffins are airy)
- Blueberry muffin: 250 x 0.4 ≈ 100 g (muffins are light, ~100 g typical)
- Coffee with creamer: ~150 ml x 1.0 ≈ 150 g, but mostly liquid; I count the creamer/milk portion at ~20 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Fried egg (fried in oil): ~196 kcal/100 g → 36 g = 71 kcal
- Toast (multigrain bread): ~250 kcal/100 g → 30 g = 75 kcal
- English muffin: ~230 kcal/100 g → 30 g = 69 kcal
- Blueberry muffin: ~380 kcal/100 g → 100 g = 380 kcal
- Creamer/milk in coffee: ~50 kcal/100 g → 20 g = 10 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total solid food ≈ 36 + 30 + 30 + 100 = 196 g, plus ~20 g creamer. Energy ≈ 605 kcal, which fits a full breakfast with a large muffin. Plausible.

Total: about 216 g, about 605 kcal.
